features.quote: Loop Limit: 20 turns max. (Spirals usually trigger by turn 10-15).
Early Stopping: To save cost, the harness should automatically kill a run if Action Stutter > 5. Once the loop is detected, running it further adds no signal, only cost.
features.justification_quote: running it further adds no signal, only cost

features.quote: Limiting context window to 8k tokens prevents runaway costs on infinite loops.
features.justification_quote: prevents runaway costs on infinite loops
